theorems.name: Submission.ind_md_closedBall_weak_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P R : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), (⨆ j, μ j univ) < ∞ → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)), StrictMono χ ∧ ν univ < ∞ ∧ ∀ F : Set (Eucl P), IsClosed F → F ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ) → limsup (fun i => μ (χ i) F) atTop ≤ ν F
